id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying enterprise connections when enterprise sso is off

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a specific, non-retryable error classification for Clerk Enterprise SSO connection failures, allowing PostHog warehouse ingestion workers to recognize account limitations and stop retrying instead of wasting resources.
review.reason: The change adds a new error classification for Clerk's enterprise_connections endpoint, distinguishing it from other errors. This is a substantive, bounded improvement: it prevents unnecessary retries for a specific, identifiable failure mode, improving reliability and resource efficiency for warehouse ingestion. The implementation and relevant test assertion are visible. No unobs된
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the warehouse ingestion worker actually encountering this specific error and the configuration allowing it to stop retrying; while the code supports this, the actual runtime behavior and configuration dependency are not demonstrated in the diff.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new non-retryable error classification for Clerk's enterprise_connections endpoint, distinguishing it from saml_connections.
observations.code_quote: "422 Client Error: Unprocessable Entity for url: https://api.clerk.com/v1/enterprise_connections": "Enterprise SSO connections aren't available on your Clerk plan or instance. Turn off syncing for this table, or enable Enterprise SSO in your Clerk dashboard.",
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the warehouse ingestion worker from retrying a failed Enterprise SSO sync, allowing PostHog to recognize account limitations and pause the warehouse connection rather than wasting retries.

observations.behavior: Adds the corresponding expected error string to the unit test for Clerk source non-retryable errors.
observations.code_quote: "422 Client Error: Unprocessable Entity for url: https://api.clerk.com/v1/enterprise_connections?limit=100 | api error: code=feature_requires_email_address_enabled",
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the test assertion to cover the newly added enterprise_connections error, ensuring regression protection for the warehouse ingestion behavior.
